people.name: Amalek
people.line: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.

translations.web: He said, “Yah has sworn: ‘Yahweh will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.’ ”
translations.bsb: “Indeed,” he said, “a hand was lifted up toward the throne of the LORD. The LORD will war against Amalek from generation to generation.”
translations.kjv: For he said, Because the LORD hath sworn that the LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.
translations.asv: And he said, Jehovah hath sworn: Jehovah will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.
